speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS).

I have noted your age and the history of tics and haloperidol use. Given your presentation of fever, altered mentation, and rigors without focal infection signs, this clinical picture is highly suggestive of NMS.
